entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: Sidi Bou Abid Mosque is a mosque overlooking the Grand Socco medina area of central Tangier, Morocco from the southwest. It was built in 1917 and is decorated in polychrome tiles. Near Bab Fahs, the Mendoubia Gardens are a double gateway leading into the medina.
